question: Archer attacks with a [The Scarab God] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron] and Nia blocks with [Scathe Zombies]. Does The Scarab God trigger?
answer_gold: No. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. However, "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers check the game state immediately before the event instead. At that point, The Scarab God had no abilities.

question: Aminah controls [Shapers' Sanctuary], [Spellskite], and [Feral Krushok]. Nico casts [Pyromatics] targeting Feral Krushok. Aminah activates Spellskite to change the target of Pyromatics to Spellskite. How many times does Shapers' Sanctuary trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. Shapers' Sanctuary will trigger the first time when Pyromatics is initially cast targeting Feral Krushok.. Shapers' Sanctuary will trigger again when Spellskite becomes the target of the spell.

question: Anderson plays their land for the turn, then casts a morphed [Zoetic Cavern]. Nataly casts [Delay] targeting Zoetic Cavern on the stack. After that resolves, Anderson casts [Timecrafting] to remove 2 time counters from Zoetic Cavern. After that resolves, Anderson casts Timecrafting to remove the last time counter from Zoetic Cavern. What happens to Zoetic Cavern?
answer_gold: It will remain in exile. Suspend allows Anderson to play it, but does not allow Anderson to play additional lands. Since they has already played their land for the turn, they cannot play Zoetic Cavern.

question: Aubree controls an [Opal Acrolith] that is currently a creature and a [Sliver Construct]. They cast [Cytoshape] to turn the Sliver Construct into a copy of Opal Acrolith. Then they activate Sliver Construct's ability to turn it into an enchantment. What happens at the end of turn?
answer_gold: The effect making Sliver Construct a copy of Opal Acrolith ends, but the effect making it an enchantment does not. It's a noncreature enchantment named "Sliver Construct" with no abilities.

question: Avery controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Evermind] on top of their library, can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Normally because Evermind has no mana cost it can't be cast. However Bolas's Citadel is casting it for an alternative cost, and therefore ignores the actual cost of the spell. When calculating the mana value of a spell with no mana cost it's considered zero.

question: Autumn controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Sidisi's Pet] on top of their library, can they cast it for its morph cost? If so, how much life will they pay?
answer_gold: No, they can't cast it. If Autumn uses Bolas's Citadel to cast a spell, they are applying an alternative cost. Morph is also an alternative cost. Only one alternative cost can be applied to a spell when casting it.

question: Ashley controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Lovestruck Beast] on top of their library. Can they cast [Heart's Desire]? If so, how much life do they pay?
answer_gold: Yes and it will cost Ashley 1 life. As part of putting Lovestruck Beast on the stack Ashley chooses whether or not they want to cast the Adventure or not. If they casts Heart's Desire they will need to pay life equal to the mana value of the spell they are casting, which in this case is one.

question: Angelique has [Copy Enchantment] enter the battlefield as a copy of [Estrid's Invocation], which is a copy of [Hardened-Scale Armor]. At the beginning of their next upkeep, which permanents may Angelique exile?
answer_gold:
Since both cards will have the ability, either Copy Enchantment and Estrid's Invocation may be exiled.

The copy effect of Estrid's Invocation includes the copy gaining an ability as part of the copying process. This is also a copiable value, and Copy Enchantment will also have this ability.

question: Alessandro controls [Angel's Tomb] and no other creatures. They cast [Mirage Phalanx]. Can they pair it with Angel's Tomb?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond is a triggered ability that will only go on the stack if Alessandro controls another eligible creature when Mirage Phalanx enters the battlefield. However, before Angel's Tomb's ability resolves, Alessandro doesn't control any other eligible creatures.

question: Ariyah controls [The Ozolith] and [Putrid Goblin] with a -1/-1 counter on it. What happens if Putrid Goblin dies?
answer_gold: Putrid Goblin will not return to the battlefield. The Ozolith will have a -1/-1 counter put on it. The Ozolith's ability does not remove counters from the creature, it just puts counters on The Ozolith matching the number and types of counters that the creature had on it when it died. Persist will look back in time to determine if Putrid Goblin had a -1/-1 counter on it at the time it died. Since it did, persist will not trigger.

question: Ares controls [Majestic Auricorn] merged with [Orochi Eggwatcher] on top. They cause Orochi Eggwatcher to flip. What happens?
answer_gold: The merged permanent will flip. The merged permanent will now use Orochi Eggwatcher's flip-side alternate characteristics. This will not affect any abilities the merged permanent has because of Majestic Auricorn, since that component is not a flip card.

question: Nico controls [Vedalken Orrery]. Axl casts [Warrior's Oath]. After it resolves, Nico casts [Trouble in Pairs]. Axl passes the turn. Who takes the next turn?
answer_gold: Nico will take the next turn. Trouble in Pairs generates a replacement effect that will replace Axl taking an extra turn with them not taking an extra turn. It doesn't matter that Trouble in Pairs was cast after Warrior's Oath was resolved, only that it is on the battlefield at the time the extra turn would begin.

question: Amaris controls a [The Flame of Keld] with 2 lore counters on it and [Soul-Scar Mage]. Amaris puts the third lore counter on The Flame of Keld and resolves its final chapter ability. Amaris then casts [Shock], targeting Nico's [River Kaijin]. How many -1/-1 counters are placed on the River Kaijin?
answer_gold: There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the damage being dealt, so Nico chooses which one to apply first. If they apply The Flame of Keld's effect first, Soul-Scar Mage's effect will then apply afterwards, and 4 -1/-1 counters will be placed on the River Kaijin. If they apply the Soul-Scar Mage's effect first, the The Flame of Keld's effect will no longer be applicable and the River Kaijin will only receive 2 -1/-1 counters.

question: Ariel controls [Mana Reflection] and [City of Traitors]. Nico controls [Damping Sphere]. If Ariel taps the City of Traitors for mana, how much mana is produced?
answer_gold: Either {C} or {C}{C}, Ariel's choice. As the ability resolves, there are two replacement effects attempting to modify it. Ariel chooses which one to apply first. If they apply Mana Reflection first, the event will become "Add {C}{C}{C}{C}" when Damping Sphere then replaces with "Add {C}". If Ariel applies Damping Sphere first, the event becomes "Add {C}", which Mana Reflection then replaces with "Add {C}{C}".

question: Amber controls a [Spellbinder] that exiled [Guardian Angel]. Nico controls a [Meddling Mage] that named "Guardian Angel". As Spellbinder's second ability resolves, what happens?
answer_gold: Amber copies the Guardian Angel in exile. Amber can't cast the copy, so it remains in exile. It ceases to exist as soon as Spellbinder's ability finishes resolving.

question: Augustine controls [Butcher Ghoul] enchanted by their [Unhallowed Pact]. They attack with it and Nico blocks with [Scaled Wurm]. Will Butcher Ghoul have a +1/+1 counter when it returns to the battlefield?
answer_gold: It's Augustine's choice. There are two triggers when Butcher Ghoul dies, so Augustine can choose the order to put them onto the stack. The first one to resolve will return the Butcher Ghoul to the battlefield, and the second one will do nothing.

question: Aspen attacks with [Aurelia, the Warleader]. Immediately after the trigger resolves, they casts [Time Stop]. Is there an additional combat phase? If so, when?
answer_gold: There is no additional combat phase. When Aurelia, the Warleader's trigger resolves, it adds the phase to the structure of the current turn. When Time Stop resolves, it skips all remaining steps and phases until the cleanup step.

question: In Aspen's draw step, they tap [Vault of Catlacan] for 8 blue mana and cast [Time Stop]. Aspen discards a [Guile] to hand size. Can they use the two remaining {U} to cast an instant?
answer_gold: No. The mana was removed from the mana pool when the draw step ended.

question: Alex controls an [Oracle of Mul Daya] and has played 2 lands this turn. They casts [Flicker], targeting the Oracle of Mul Daya. After if resolves, can they play a 3rd land?
answer_gold: No. Alex has 1 land play this turn by default, which Oracle of Mul Daya increase to 2. Alex has already played 2 lands this turn, so no more lands can be played.

question: Ariel controls [Bastion Inventor] and an [Oblivion Ring] that exiled Noelle's [Ghostly Possession]. Noelle casts [Serene Offering] targeting Oblivion Ring. What happens as the Ghostly Possession returns to the battlefield?
answer_gold: It enchants Bastion Inventor. Auras entering the battlefield from a zone other than the stack must enchant a legal object. It doesn't target anything, so hexproof doesn't matter.

question: Ainsley controls [Everlasting Torment] and casts [Soul Burn] with X = 2 targeting Nixon's [Forest Bear]. (Spending {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.) How much life does Ainsley gain?
answer_gold: 0. The instructions of the spell are carried out in order. By the time Ainsley would gain life, the creature's toughness has been reduced to 0 by the -1/-1 counters, so they can't gain more than 0 life.

question: Andy controls 3 artifacts and casts [Rusted Relic]. Neriah controls [Imposing Sovereign]. Does Rusted Relic enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Tapped. To determine what replacement effects apply to a permanent as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Rusted Relic would be a creature, so Imposing Sovereign's effect will apply to it.

question: Nathaniel controls [Pithing Needle] naming [Skullsnatcher]. Alex has Skullsnatcher in their hand and declares an attack with [Borderland Minotaur]. Nathaniel declares no blockers. Can Alex use ninjutsu to put Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Ninjutsu is an activated ability.

question: Azariah controls [Magus of the Moon] and plays [Three Tree City]. Do they make a choice for it as it enters? If not, what happens if Magus of the Moon leaves the battlefield later?
answer_gold:
No. Making a choice for Three Tree City as it enters is a replacement effect. When determining which replacement effects apply to Three Tree City as it's entering the battlefield, the game looks at how it will exist on the battlefield after it enters. On the battlefield Three Tree City is a Mountain, and Mountains don't make choices as they enter.

If the Magus of the Moon leaves the battlefield later on, Three Tree City is not entering the battlefield again, so it will simply have had no choice made for it.

question: Ari attacks with [Suntail Hawk]. Nayeli casts [Vault Skyward] to give [Brimaz, King of Oreskos] flying until end of turn and blocks Suntail Hawk. Will the token created by Brimaz, King of Oreskos also be blocking Suntail Hawk?
answer_gold: Yes. The only time the game checks to see if the declaration of blockers is illegal is as Nayeli declares blockers. A creature that's put onto the battlefield blocking isn't declared as a blocker and isn't affected by requirements or restrictions that normally alter what a player is allowed to declare as a blocker.

question: Aryan splice [Evermind] onto [Barrel Down Sokenzan]. Can they target [Phyrexian Crusader] with the spliced spell?
answer_gold: No. Evermind has a color indicator that makes it blue, and that will not be spliced onto Barrel Down Sokenzan because it's not a part of its text box.

question: Armani controls [Soul Echo] with 0 counters on it and Nico controls [Spirit of the Hearth]. Will Armani have to sacrifice Soul Echo at the beginning of their upkeep?
answer_gold: No. Since the ability has no legal targets, it would trigger at the beginning of the upkeep but would not be put on the stack.

question: Addison controls [The Book of Vile Darkness], and token copies of [Eye of Vecna] and [Hand of Vecna] created by [Saheeli's Artistry]. Addison then activates The Book of Vile Darkness. What abilities will the Vecna token have?
answer_gold: Only indestructible and "At the beginning of your end step, if you lost 2 or more life this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.". It won't get the abilities of the exiled tokens, because they're not cards.

question: Aspen casts [Buried Alive] while controlling [Extus, Oriq Overlord]. Can they put [Virulent Sliver] into their graveyard with Buried Alive, and return it with Extus, Oriq Overlord's triggered ability?
answer_gold: No. Extus, Oriq Overlord triggers when Aspen casts Buried Alive, and will go on the stack above it. At this point, a legal target has to be chosen. The ability will then resolve before the spell that caused it to trigger does.

question: Aiyana casts [Murktide Regent], exiling 5 instants. In response, Nico casts [Dress Down]. How many +1/+1 counters will Murktide Regent enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Zero. When determining how to apply Murktide Regent's replacement effect, its characteristics are checked as it would exist on the battlefield. Since Dress Down is on the battlefield, Murktide Regent would have no abilities while on the battlefield, so its replacement effect won't apply.

question: Nathaniel controls [Dryad Militant]. Armani casts [Hanabi Blast]. Does it return to their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Resolving spells do not leave the stack until they finish resolving. Returning the Hanabi Blast to its owner's hand is part of its resolution, so it is never put into exile.

question: In a two-player game, Ally casts [Rushblade Commander]. Can they attack with it this turn?
answer_gold: Yes. In a two-player game, "your team" means "you".

question: Alberto casts [Parch] with its second mode, targeting Nico's [Kasimir the Lone Wolf]. In response, Nico casts [Prismatic Lace], choosing red. What happens when Parch resolves?
answer_gold: The Kasimir the Lone Wolf is now a mono-red permanent; it is no longer blue. The game checks to see if its targets are still legal. Kasimir the Lone Wolf is no longer a legal target for Parch, so it is removed from the stack and doesn't resolve.

question: Alfonso has 20 life and has cast a [Channel] previously this turn. Nancy casts [Word of Command], choosing [Squire] from Alfonso's hand. Can Nancy have Alfonso pay 20 life to add 20 colorless mana while casting the Squire, causing Alfonso to lose the game?
answer_gold: Yes. There is no restriction on how much mana Alfonso can add while casting Squire. While Word of Command does prevent Alfonso from activating mana abilities that aren't used to cast Squire, paying 1 life to add {C} due to Channel is not a mana ability, it is a special action.

question: Aimee casts [Animate Dead] targeting [Scalebane's Elite] in their graveyard. What happens?
answer_gold:
Both permanents end up in the graveyard.

Scalebane's Elite's protection ability doesn't function in the graveyard, so it's a legal target for Animate Dead. As Animate Dead's trigger resolves, first Animate Dead's enchant ability changes to "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead". Then Scalebane's Elite is returned to the battlefield. At this point the next instruction is to attach Animate Dead to Scalebane's Elite, but this is illegal to do because now that it's on the battlefield, Scalebane's Elite's protection ability is active.

After the triggered ability from Animate Dead has finished resolving, the game will check state-based actions and see that Animate Dead is an Aura that isn't enchanting anything, so it's put into its owner's graveyard.. This causes Animate Dead's leaves-the-battlefield ability to trigger, sacrificing Scalebane's Elite.

question: Alondra controls an [Invasion of Ixalan] with 1 defense counter on it. They attack it with [Rankle and Torbran]. If they choose the second mode for Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability, could they sacrifice Invasion of Ixalan's back face [Belligerent Regisaur] to it?
answer_gold: Yes. When Rankle and Torbran attacks Invasion of Ixalan and removes the last defense counter from it, both Invasion of Ixalan and Rankle and Torbran's abilities will trigger. Alondra will get to choose the order in which the abilities go on the stack, so they could put Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability on the stack first with Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability on top. Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability will resolve first, so Invasion of Ixalan will be exiled and Alondra could choose to cast it transformed. When Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability resolves, Belligerent Regisaur will have resolved and be on the battlefield, so Alondra could choose to sacrifice it.

question: Noah activates [Thespian's Stage] targeting a [Dark Depths] with ten ice counters on it. What happens?
answer_gold: Thespian's Stage becomes a copy of Dark Depths. Thespian's Stage has no ice counters on it, so its state trigger triggers, but doesn't go on the stack yet. Then state-based actions are checked and Noah has to put either Dark Depths or Thespian's Stage into their graveyard. Then Thespian's Stage's trigger goes on the stack, and if Thespian's Stage is still on the battlefield during the resolution of the trigger, Noah sacrifices it and creates a 20/20 Marit Lage token.

question: Ashley controls [Underworld Breach] and has [Reveillark] in their graveyard. Can they evoke it?
answer_gold: No. Escape and evoke are both alternative costs ([702.138a], [702.74a]), and Ashley may only pay one alternative cost for a spell. Since escape is the only thing that allows Ashley to cast Reveillark from their graveyard, they have to use that cost.

question: Autumn controls [Slimefoot, the Stowaway] and a 1/1 Saproling token. Autumn casts [Deafening Clarion] choosing both modes. How much life does Autumn gain?
answer_gold:
Two.

Deafening Clarion deals three damage to each creature, then gives them lifelink. After the spell has resolved, state-based actions are checked and both creatures die. Slimefoot, the Stowaway's ability is a leave-the-battlefield trigger, so it sees that it existed immediately before Slimefoot, the Stowaway died and therefore triggers. When it resolves, it sees that Slimefoot, the Stowaway had lifelink right before it died, so Autumn gains 1 life from the damage that's dealt to Noor.

question: Ace controls [Soul Warden] and casts [Realmwalker]. Can Natalie kill it before Ace casts a creature from the top of their library?
answer_gold: Yes. When Realmwalker enters the battlefield Soul Warden's trigger will go on the stack, at which point both players will have a chance to respond.

question: Alondra has 10 life and Nico has 20 life. Alondra attacks Nico with [Kaalia of the Vast] and puts in [Scourge of the Throne]. Will they get an extra combat phase?
answer_gold: No. Scourge of the Throne has a triggered ability that occurs only when it is declared as an attacking creature. It was put onto the battlefield attacking, which doesn't meet its trigger condition.

question: Alma deals combat damage to Nico with their [Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer]. They exile [Deceit] from Nico's library. Can Alma evoke Deceit?
answer_gold: Yes. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer's trigger creates a continuous effect that lets Alma cast Deceit this turn, with no restrictions on how it's cast. Alma is free to cast Deceit for its alternative cost by evoking it.

question: Amiyah taps their [The One Ring], which currently has no burden counters on it, to draw a card. Before that resolves Nico casts [Soul Partition] targeting The One Ring. How many cards does Amiyah draw when the activated ability resolves?
answer_gold: None. When The One Ring's ability resolves it can't put a burden counter on The One Ring because it's no longer on the battlefield. The game uses its last known information to determine how many burden counters were on The One Ring before it was exiled.

question: Nathaniel controls [Rest in Peace] and [Dauthi Voidwalker], and Armani casts [Read the Bones]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Armani gets to choose which replacement effect applies to it. After applying that effect, it's no longer moving to the graveyard, so the other effect doesn't apply. It'll end up in exile either way, but Armani gets to choose whether it has a void counter on it.

question: Aspen control [Pulmonic Sliver]. They cast [Dihada's Ploy], discarding [Dregscape Sliver] on resolution. Can Aspen put Dregscape Sliver on top of their library?
answer_gold: No. Pulmonic Sliver's ability affects only Sliver permanents on the battlefield, and not Sliver cards in other zones.

question: Arely controls a [Barony Vampire]. Nico controls a [Trained Jackal]. Arely casts [Prey Upon], targeting the Barony Vampire and Trained Jackal. In response, Nico casts [Hanabi Blast], targeting the Barony Vampire. What happens?
answer_gold: The Hanabi Blast resolves, removing the Barony Vampire from the battlefield. Prey Upon resolves, but no damage is dealt to the Trained Jackal.

question: Annabel controls [Altar of Dementia] and casts [Too Greedily, Too Deep] returning Nolan's [Sepulchral Primordial] to the battlefield. Can Annabel use Altar of Dementia to sacrifice Sepulchral Primordial and return it to the battlefield using its own triggered ability?
answer_gold: No. Annabel must choose a target for Sepulchral Primordial's triggered ability as it is put onto the stack. At this time, Sepulchral Primordial is still on the battlefield.

question: Ari casts [Memories Returning]. Does Noor have a chance to exile it with [Dawnhand Dissident] before Ari can cast Memories Returning again for its flashback cost?
answer_gold:
No. After Memories Returning resolves, Ari receives priority.. At this point, Memories Returning is in the graveyard, and they can choose to cast it again. When it's cast, it goes from the graveyard to the stack. Noor does not receive priority until after Memories Returning is on the stack, so Memories Returning can't be exiled with Dawnhand Dissident.

(Unless there's something else on the battlefield that would create a triggered ability when Memories Returning resolves. In that case, Ari wouldn't be able to cast Memories Returning until the trigger has left the stack, and Noor could exile it in response to the trigger.)

question: Aubrey and Arely are playing 2HG. Aubrey attacks with [Coral Commando] and Arely casts [Flash Conscription] to gain control of Coral Commando after it's been declared as an attacker in the declare attackers step. Is it still attacking?
answer_gold: No. A creature that changes controllers is removed from combat. Even though Aubrey and Arely are on the same team and are both allowed to be attacking with creatures, they are different players and therefore Arely gaining control of Aubrey's creature still qualifies as a control change.

question: Axel controls [Vastwood Gorger] and attacks Nico's [Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset]. Before damage is dealt, Nico activates [Barrin, Master Wizard], sacrificing Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset. Does Vastwood Gorger deal damage? If so, to what?
answer_gold: No, Vastwood Gorger does not deal any combat damage. When combat damage would be assigned, a creature that is not currently attacking anything does not deal combat damage.
